implementing-architecture 1.0.2

- Clarified usage for brownfield scenarios: this skill now explicitly applies when refactoring existing prototypes/codebases to conform to an approved architecture (not just greenfield implementation).
- Added "Brownfield rule": made clear that existing code is not architectural authority; implementation means bringing code into compliance, not treating prototypes as source of truth.
- Expanded "When NOT to Use" with rules for handling prototypes and what to do if architecture changes are needed.
- No behavioral or technical changes—documentation/business process clarification only.
